text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We've gathered enough members to take on 
the Aoharu Cup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Exciting! Team training is so thrilling, 
yes~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Today happens to be a very auspicious 
day! A sure sign of great success for the 
team!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What should we do for today's team 
training!? How about a game of tag with 
the whole team!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: C-Can Rice... really keep up with you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to join forces with my unique 
teammates and keep doing my best more and 
more from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oooone! Twooo! Threeee! Foooour!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fiiive! Siiix! Seeeven! Eiiight!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Two, two, three, four... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Fiiive! Siiix! Seeeven! Eiiight!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Being with everyone is so very 
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Watching from the outside like this really 
teaches you a lot! Like, seeing what parts 
they're training and all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's just like a mirror, how fun~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, she can stretch out that far... 
Alright, Rice will too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They work through their training menu with 
cheerful energy, constantly inspiring one 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The team is running smoothly! Just as I 
was feeling relieved—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: OK! Everybody stop! It's break time!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What should I do...? To tell, or not to 
tell...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hohya!? Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well, um... I believe she is currently 
jogging south-southeast—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today's auspicious direction is 
north-northwest, and since it's the exact 
opposite direction, I'm a bit concerned 
about the omens...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but I wonder if we might be getting 
in the way of everyone's training...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, after all, it's the direction our 
team chose! Everything will be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The other members too—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The jogging pace... I was wondering if it 
might be too fast for some of the girls...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Still, maybe everyone else doesn't see 
it that way, though...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! N-Never mind, it's 
nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even try to stop her, she 
dashed off—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer. Do you think I should 
keep quiet~?
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, whenever I see a butterfly or 
something, I always want to tell everyone 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But you know, whenever I say that during 
training, everyone gets startled or just 
freezes up.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So... yep, my mind's made up! No 
chitchatting during team training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even Taiki Shuttle, who had appeared to be 
enjoying team training—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Waaahhh~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After soothing the tearful Taiki Shuttle, 
I asked for the full story, and—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to get closer to everyone, so I 
tried throwing a party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to invite you after training... 
but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy everyone! Tonightâ

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Somehow, I feel more tired than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice... will too... *zzz*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I couldn't bring myself to invite them...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Usually, I would just shout "GO GO!", 
but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Knowing we'd be teammates working hard 
together from now on, I just couldn't 
bring myself to say it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"And... going back to my decorated room 
feels so sad that I just can't bring 
myself to go home, desu~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While they enjoyed team training, the 
members all seemed somewhat constrained.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In contrast, Team <First>—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
200 meters left! You're dropping back! 
Don't just swing your legs high, drive off 
the ground!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like everyone has finished all 
their training menus.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to finish up, I will compare 
today's times against the target times I 
set the other day.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Keeping daily track of your goal and 
current position is essential to achieving 
your objectives. Please proceed in order.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Target time for 3,000m: 3 minutes 6.2 
seconds. Today's time: 3 minutes 10.3 
seconds.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Target time for 2400m: 2 minutes 26.4 
seconds! Today's time: exactly 2 minutes 
30 seconds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Team First called out their target times 
and current times one after another.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If nothing is lacking, everyone 
should reach their target times within a 
year and a half.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you're used to it by now, but 
just in case. Don't forget your review 
study and daily log once you return to the 
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Team <First>
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: —Well then, that will be all for today.

text_block_list.name: Team <First>
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm completely wiped out today too! 
I wanna get home fast and take a shower!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
My stamina should be improving, but... No, 
is this all part of Trainer Kashimoto's 
calculations too?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer Kashimoto really is amazing 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Team First seems to be diligently training 
under Acting Director Kashimoto's 
instruction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Can we really win our way through the 
Aoharu Cup like this? My anxiety only 
continues to grow..."
